items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I played down with Paul, Paul, Paul, Paul, Emilio Bon.

ctx.x: Yeah, it's funny, wasn't it? Did you ever play at the old place?

Yeah, I played down there with Billy and you did. I didn't stay down there long. I didn't stay down there long. And I played down with Paul, Paul, Paul, Paul, Emilio Bon. I played down there a while, not long though.
Any other bands that you can pick of that you played with or musicians or any other jobs you had for a while? Where have you been playing in recent years before you had this present job?
